thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.entry:
MAS OS - Ready.
What are your commands ?
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.go-to-scroll-logs: Look up Vellum Scroll's personal log
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.lookup-sentinel-imprint: Look up Sentinel magical imprint process
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.scroll-logs/holodisk-entry:
MA OS - The program executed successfully.

2 files modified
387 files destroyed
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.scroll-logs/searched: You successfully gained access to Vellum Scroll's personal logs.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.search-computer: Search the computer for anything interesting
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.search-failure: Some hidden file has caught your attention, but it's access protected, and you just couldn't manage to read them.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.search-over: You look upon the files, and see nothing that catch your interest.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/searched: You hacked your way into some suspicious encrypted files. They are design documents for a sensible project called Sentinel.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/entry: The console lights up with Sentinel's authentication protocol. The magical imprint is right there, waiting to be claimed - or wiped out for good.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-imprint-attempt-self: Try to apply the imprint on yourself
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/imprint-success: Arcane script crawls up the console and into you. Something settles at the back of your skull - cold, vast, and now unmistakably yours. Sentinel has a new master.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/imprint-failure: The ritual slips out of your grasp. Whatever this imprint is made of, it isn't ready to answer to you yet.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/destroyed: The console sparks, then goes dark for good. Whatever Sentinel might have become, it never will now.
thornhoof/laboratory/laboratory-terminal.sentinel-lookup/rathian-intervenes:
Before you can finish, Rathian grabs your hoof away from the console.
"Not like this."
